caption:
The math nobody says out loud. 🧮

$2,000 on a card at 22% APR, carried for a year: about $440 in interest.
Paid in full each month: $0.

Same purchase. Very different cost.

What would you do with an extra $440?
first_comment: What would you do with $440 back in your pocket? 👇
